control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during an intrusive maintenance task on TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-9001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 30 December 2019 an incident occurred on TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
